messages.text:
"Create a 2d pixel Pokémon game mirroring pokemon yellow version on gameboy color. You play as a team rocket grunt in a run down base who works his way through the ranks. People have stats like pokemon and can fight trainers as well as steal pokemon. As you progress you unlock upgrades for your character and improve your base.  As a grunt you can work and manage the game corner which contains a functional slot machine game playable as a grunt. The slot machine should payout credits used to buy upgrades for the entire pokemon game. As you rank up you unlock ways to improve the probability of higher payouts, payout size and get better prizes to buy when redeeming credits. You can work at the Pokémon daycare which doubles as an unground Pokémon breeding and fusion laboratory with a secret fighting club tournament were tiers are unlocked as you progress the story. You unlock access to the fusion lab as you rank up. Ranking up requires pokemon collection, taking over pokemon gyms and progression into controlling towns. There needs to be a rival protagonist who's story progresses as we rank up. There needs to be a rival within team rocket trying to be better than us. When you reach boss rank you can fight the elite 4 and corrupt the entire pokemon league. Reaching boss rank unlocks advanced organization management and the ability to further develope team rocket

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
